Definition: from the base of G4226 and G5037; interrogative adverb, at what time:--+ how long, when.
BiblicalUsage: Pote asks when, at what time. The disciples ask when the temple shall fall, and the Pharisees ask when the kingdom of God should come, and Jesus answers both with a warning against watching the wrong signs.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that when questions belong to God, and my job is readiness, not a date.
